title: AI for Coda
summary: Jordan spent the evening weighing whether to add an AI recommendation engine to Coda, eventually deciding it's overkill for now—better to keep v1 simple with streaks and gaps and let musicians decide for themselves, revisiting AI features later once actual user needs are clearer. Along the way, Jordan got reflective about using this same journal companion, feeling genuinely helped by its pattern-spotting but uneasy about whether that's real self-knowledge or just delegating it to a machine. The tone throughout is thoughtful and unresolved, more exploratory than anxious, landing on one concrete decision (simplify Coda) while leaving the bigger question about AI and self-reflection open.
